exposure: Wharton's jelly mesenchymal stem cells (WJMSCs)-derived small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) preparations (Low Dose: 3 x 10^9 particle/rat)
Wharton's jelly mesenchymal stem cells (WJMSCs)-derived small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) preparations (High Dose: 9 x 10^9 particles/rat)
cohort: Twenty-four rats were fed a high-fat and high-fructose diet to induce metabolic syndrome.
finding: Human fetal WJMSCs-derived sEVs preparations significantly reduced fasting blood glucose, triglycerides, and blood pressure, and increased HDL levels, while also improving inflammation and hemorrhage in the lung and mineralization in the renal in MetS rats, though abdominal circumference did not significantly improve.
